## Purpose

Provides comprehensive Drizzle ORM patterns for schema definition, CRUD operations, relations, queries, transactions, and migrations. Proactively use for any Drizzle ORM development. Supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MSSQL, and CockroachDB.
